title: Co-deposition of Ni–Mo alloy film catalysts for hydrogen evolution from an ethylene glycol system
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34165-34174
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06466F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinkuai He, Yiren Li, Jingjing Yang, Genfa Zeng, Luye Wu
The electrochemical behaviors of nickel and molybdenum ions in ethylene glycol were studied. Moreover, it was found that the alloy films exhibited excellent electrocatalytic performance for hydrogen evolution (η10 = 74 mV).
